payload.reasoning_summary: Accept a narrowed vertical slice of IDEA-001. The full proposal combines several independent foundations and is too large for one reviewable change. Canonical encoding and its mandatory ADR are the highest-value legal unit because FASE-1 requires ADR-009 and CanonicalEncoder before any StateHash implementation.
risks: An underspecified type-tag or length-framing scheme could make encodings ambiguous; ADR golden vectors must fix the byte format before implementation is accepted.
JavaScript string ordering is not equivalent to UTF-8 byte ordering for every key, so tests must exercise divergent cases.
Unordered-collection sorting can become nondeterministic if based on runtime comparison or insertion order instead of encoded bytes.

acceptance_criteria: ADR-009 is committed under docs/decisions and fully specifies byte-level encodings for every supported type, object keys, ordered collections, unordered collections, and all rejected values.
CanonicalEncoder output conforms to ADR-009 and is deterministic for repeated encoding of the same logical value.
Objects or maps with identical entries but different insertion order produce identical bytes, with keys ordered by their UTF-8 byte sequences rather than locale-sensitive comparison.
Unordered collections with identical logical members but different insertion order produce identical bytes; ordered collections preserve order and produce different bytes when element order differs.

Values that are logically distinct by supported type or structure do not share an encoding in the required collision-separation test corpus, including bigint versus safe integer and ordered versus unordered collections.
Encoding rejects undefined, NaN, positive and negative Infinity, negative zero, unsafe integers, unsupported runtime values, and cyclic structures with deterministic typed errors.
No StateHash or SaveHash implementation is introduced by this change.
Core sources pass the repository typecheck, lint, determinism lint, and package-boundary checks.
must_preserve: Existing determinism lint invariants, including no Math.random, floating-point-dependent behavior, transcendental functions, locale-sensitive ordering, or nondeterministic iteration in deterministic core code.
INV-22 canonical save/state representation requirements that apply to this component.
No computation may be labeled StateHash before ADR-009 and the canonical encoder are established.
task.objective: Record the canonical encoding decision and implement a deterministic CanonicalEncoder for the value domain required by FASE-1.
out_of_scope: Nominal Money, Quantity, Price, Rate, or Tick types.
World generation, ledger, tick loop, replay CLI, Electron, or packaging work.
A decoder or serialization round-trip API.
required_adrs: ADR-009: canonical encoding format, supported value domain, ordering rules, rejection rules, and encoding-version policy
required_tests: Golden byte-vector tests for every supported scalar and collection form documented by ADR-009.
UTF-8 byte-order tests using keys whose ordering differs from ordinary locale or UTF-16 ordering.
Insertion-order permutation tests for objects, maps, and unordered collections.
Type/structure separation tests covering bigint versus integer, scalar versus collection, object keys versus values, and ordered versus unordered collections.
Rejection tests for undefined, NaN, both infinities, negative zero, unsafe integers, unsupported values, and cyclic references.
Run the existing full test suite plus repository typecheck, lint, determinism lint, and package-boundary validation.
scope: Create ADR-009 in docs/decisions before introducing any StateHash computation.
Define the supported canonical value model and encode it without relying on JSON serialization semantics.
Encode object/map keys in UTF-8 byte order.
Encode bigint as signed decimal ASCII and safe integers with an unambiguous type marker.
Reject undefined, NaN, Infinity, negative zero, unsafe integers, unsupported values, and cyclic structures.
Provide explicit encodings for ordered and unordered collections; unordered collection output must be independent of insertion order.
Export CanonicalEncoder from packages/core using existing package boundaries.
